## PR title

Remember: this repo squash-merges, so the PR title becomes the changelog/version-bump entry. It must follow [Conventional Commits](CONTRIBUTING.md#pr-titles-conventional-commits) (`feat: ...`, `fix: ...`, `feat!: ...` for a breaking change).
